newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS RANGERS END ON LOSING NOTE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHAMPIONS RANGERS END ON LOSING NOTE.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers ended their Scottish premier division season in defeat on Saturday, three days after securing their ninth consecutive league title.
The champions, who won 1-0 at Dundee United on Wednesday to clinch the crown, were beaten 3-1 by Hearts in Edinburgh.
All the goals came in the last 10 minutes, Colin Cameron putting Hearts ahead in the 80th before Derek McInnes equalised 60 seconds later.
John Robertson then swung the match decisively Hearts' way by scoring from a spot kick in the 82nd minute and adding his second goal in the 86th.
Rangers finished the premier division programme five points clear of runners-up and city arch-rivals Celtic.
Celtic ended with a 3-0 home victory over Dundee United.
Portugal striker Jorge Cadete fired the Glasgow side ahead after 11 minutes and late goals from Chris Hay and Tommy Johnson sealed success.
